newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NSW state calls for Australian rate cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NSW state calls for Australian rate cut.

text.p: The New South Wales state goverment on Tuesday joined calls for a further cut in Australia's official interest rates.

NSW Treasurer Micheal Egan said that a 0.5 percent cut in official rates from the current level of 7.0 percent was needed to stimulate the flat labour market and head off effects of the Australian government's spending cuts.
Egan said the job market was flat and the national economy was not growing fast enough to reduce employment.
"We need an immediate rate to innoculate the job market against the effects of Federal Government fiscal tightening and boost job creation," Egan said in a statement.
Australian cash rates were last cut by 50 basis points on July 31 and most economists expect another rate reduction around November.
